name: Kotani Miyuki
source:
Toshiya's friend. She's Toshiya's friend and also Haruhiro's girlfriend.

They're childhood friends, but somehow she and Haruhiro ended up in a serious relationship.

She gives advice on married life from a woman's perspective (?).

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/okusama/chara.html]official site[/url]]
